quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: She baked the cookies in the oven until golden brown.
She shaped the dough into small round cookies.
Grandma mixed flour, sugar, and butter in a large bowl.
quests.hint: Dough needs to be shaped by hand before it's ready to go into the oven.
quests.explanation: Baking follows clear steps: mixing the ingredients comes first, shaping the dough is next, and baking happens last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: They added color with paint once the sketches were done.
The art teacher gave each student a blank sheet of paper.
Students sketched their favorite animals with pencils.
quests.hint: A sketch is normally drawn in pencil before any paint is added on top.
quests.explanation: Getting the paper comes first, sketching follows, and painting is the final step once the drawing is ready.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The Wilsons' cat stopped eating and seemed very tired.
The vet found a small infection and prescribed medicine.
They took her to the vet for a check-up.
quests.hint: A visit to the vet usually happens only after an owner notices something is wrong.
quests.explanation: Noticing the cat's illness comes first, the vet visit follows, and the diagnosis and treatment happen last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Children rushed outside to build their first snowman.
Snow began to fall softly over the sleeping village.
By morning, a thick white blanket covered every rooftop.
quests.hint: Snow needs time to fall and build up before it's deep enough to cover every rooftop.
quests.explanation: The snowfall starts the scene, accumulation follows overnight, and the children's excitement comes only after they see the snow.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Visitors walked between the stalls, tasting fresh samples.
Farmers set up their stalls early at the weekend market.
By noon, many stalls had already sold out of vegetables.
quests.hint: A market has to be set up before any visitors are able to arrive and shop.
quests.explanation: Setting up the stalls comes first, shopping follows, and the results — like selling out — appear later in the day.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Tom downloaded a new language app onto his phone.
By the end of the month, he could hold a simple conversation.
He completed a short lesson every day for a month.
quests.hint: An app has to be downloaded before anyone is able to start using it.
quests.explanation: Downloading the app starts the process, daily practice follows, and real progress is the final result.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Everyone gathered in the backyard for a big lunch.
Relatives from different cities traveled to Grandpa's house.
They took a large family photo before saying goodbye.
quests.hint: People need to arrive at a place before any gathering can actually begin there.
quests.explanation: Traveling to the house comes first, the gathering follows, and the photo is taken near the end, before everyone leaves.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: She decided to go for a brisk walk in the park.
Priya felt tired after sitting at her desk all day.
She returned home feeling refreshed and full of energy.
quests.hint: A decision to exercise usually comes right after someone first notices they feel tired.
quests.explanation: Feeling tired is the starting point, the walk is the action taken, and feeling refreshed is the final result.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: They finally parked outside a cozy cabin by the lake.
They drove for three hours along a winding mountain road.
The Garcia family loaded their car with bags and snacks.
quests.hint: A car needs to be packed before a family is able to start driving anywhere.
quests.explanation: Packing the car comes first, the drive itself follows, and arriving at the cabin is the final step of the trip.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The band walked on stage as the crowd cheered loudly.
Fans lined up outside the stadium hours before the show.
The doors opened, and everyone rushed to find good seats.
quests.hint: A crowd usually waits outside a venue for a while before the doors are opened.
quests.explanation: Waiting in line comes first, entering the venue follows, and the performance begins only once everyone is seated.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: He placed tomato seedlings carefully into each hole.
He watered the new plants and covered them with soil.
Mr. Patel dug small holes along the edge of his garden.
quests.hint: A hole needs to be ready in the ground before a seedling can be placed inside it.
quests.explanation: Digging the holes comes first, planting the seedlings follows, and watering them is the final step.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The town library announced a free weekend book sale.
By closing time, almost every book had found a new home.
Dozens of readers arrived early to browse the tables.
quests.hint: An event usually needs to be announced before people know to show up for it.
quests.explanation: The announcement comes first, the crowd's arrival follows, and the sale's success is clear by the end of the day.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The couple shared their first dance as newlyweds.
She walked down the aisle as guests smiled and watched.
Anna chose a beautiful white dress for her wedding day.
quests.hint: A dress is usually chosen well before the wedding day itself actually happens.
quests.explanation: Choosing the dress happens in preparation, the ceremony follows, and the celebration — like the first dance — comes last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: He called the office technician to look at the problem.
The technician fixed the issue in just ten minutes.
Mr. Reyes noticed his computer was running very slowly.
quests.hint: A technician is usually called only after a problem has already been discovered.
quests.explanation: Discovering the problem starts the story, calling for help follows, and the fix happens last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: By the end of the lesson, they could swim across the pool.
The children practiced the strokes slowly in the shallow end.
Coach Lee showed the young swimmers the correct arm movements.
quests.hint: Learning a brand-new skill usually starts with instruction before any practice begins.
quests.explanation: The lesson begins with instruction, practice follows, and real progress is the final outcome.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: They unpacked the food and enjoyed a relaxing lunch.
They spread a large blanket under a shady oak tree.
The Nguyen family prepared sandwiches and fruit the night before.
quests.hint: Food is usually prepared at home before a family even heads out for a picnic.
quests.explanation: Preparing the food comes first, setting up the picnic spot follows, and eating together is the final, relaxing step.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: On exam day, they answered every question with confidence.
Their teacher returned the graded papers a few days later.
Students studied their notes carefully for a whole week.
quests.hint: Studying usually happens well before an exam, not after it is finished.
quests.explanation: Studying comes first, taking the exam follows, and receiving the results is the final step in the process.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Leila's phone rang with a video call from her cousin abroad.
They promised to call again the following weekend.
She answered and they chatted happily for almost an hour.
quests.hint: A call needs to be answered before any real conversation is able to begin.
quests.explanation: The incoming call starts the scene, the conversation follows, and the promise to talk again comes at the very end.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: He caught the bus just as it pulled up to the stop.
Carlos left his apartment fifteen minutes before his shift started.
He arrived at work with a few minutes to spare.
quests.hint: Someone has to leave home before they're able to catch a bus outside.
quests.explanation: Leaving the apartment comes first, catching the bus follows, and arriving at work is the final step of the commute.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: She compared prices at three different stores downtown.
She finally chose a scarf and had it gift-wrapped.
Hana wanted to find the perfect gift for her sister.
quests.hint: Comparing options usually happens before a shopper is ready to make a final choice.
quests.explanation: Wanting to find a gift starts the search, comparing prices follows, and choosing the final gift comes last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: He felt exhausted and struggled to focus the next day.
That night, he decided to turn off his devices earlier.
Ethan stayed up late playing games on his tablet.
quests.hint: A consequence usually follows an action, and a new decision often follows that consequence.
quests.explanation: Staying up late is the cause, feeling tired is the effect, and the decision to change is the final result.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: They rested in their room before exploring the city.
The next morning, they set out to visit the museum.
The Adams family checked into their hotel after a long flight.
quests.hint: Guests need to check in at the front desk before they can rest in their room.
quests.explanation: Checking in comes first, resting follows, and sightseeing begins only after they've had time to recover.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The cousins spread a board game across the kitchen table.
After an hour, one cousin finally won the game.
They rolled the dice and took turns moving their pieces.
quests.hint: A game needs to be set up on the table before anyone can actually start playing it.
quests.explanation: Setting up the game comes first, playing it follows, and the winner is revealed only at the end.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The plumber found and fixed a small leak within an hour.
Water began dripping slowly from the kitchen ceiling.
Mr. Osei called a plumber to check the pipes upstairs.
quests.hint: A problem is usually noticed at home before someone decides to call for professional help.
quests.explanation: The dripping water is the problem, calling the plumber is the response, and fixing the leak is the final solution.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: A month later, the family finally settled into a routine.
The Kellers welcomed a new baby girl into their family.
Neighbors brought over meals and small gifts to help out.
quests.hint: An event usually needs to happen before neighbors are able to respond to it with support.
quests.explanation: The baby's arrival starts the story, the community's support follows, and settling into a routine is the final stage.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Trash had been piling up along the riverside path for weeks.
By the afternoon, the path looked clean and welcoming again.
Volunteers gathered on Saturday morning with gloves and bags.
quests.hint: A problem usually exists for a while before volunteers organize to fix it.
quests.explanation: The trash problem comes first, the volunteer effort follows, and the clean result is shown at the end.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: He finally had enough money to buy the bike he wanted.
Every week, Diego saved a small part of his allowance.
After two months, his savings jar was almost full.
quests.hint: Money usually needs to be saved over time before it's enough for a big purchase.
quests.explanation: Saving starts the process, the growing savings show progress, and buying the bike is the final reward.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: Each group researched their topic and prepared a poster.
The teacher divided the class into small project groups.
Every group presented their poster to the class on Friday.
quests.hint: Groups need to be formed before any research work can actually begin.
quests.explanation: Forming the groups comes first, the research and preparation follow, and the presentations happen last.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: She collected the printed pages and placed them in a folder.
She connected her laptop to the printer in the study.
Aisha's essay was finally finished after hours of writing.
quests.hint: Writing usually has to be finished before a document is ready to print.
quests.explanation: Finishing the essay comes first, printing it follows, and organizing the pages is the final step.

quests.instruction: Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a logical paragraph.
shuffledSentences: The starting gun fired, and the runners sprinted forward.
Runners lined up nervously at the starting line of the race.
The crowd cheered as the first runner crossed the finish line.
quests.hint: Runners need to be in position at the line before a race is allowed to officially start.
quests.explanation: Lining up comes first, the race itself follows the starting signal, and crossing the finish line is the final moment.
